description: This file implements the leader_list_manager class for managing leader selection in the Wesnoth game, including updating leader lists, setting and getting leaders, and handling GUI combo box interactions.

classes.name: leader_list_manager
classes.description: Manages leader selection, updating leader lists, and GUI interactions for leader choices in the game.

methods.name: set_combo
methods.description: Sets the combo box widget and updates the leader list if not null.

methods.name: update_leader_list
methods.description: Updates the list of leaders based on the side configuration and populates the combo box.

methods.name: set_leader
methods.description: Sets the selected leader in the combo box based on the leader name.

methods.name: get_leader
methods.description: Returns the currently selected leader's name.
